RIGHT PROFILE: continuous solid hair cap covering ENTIRE crown AND rear skull (LEFT side) down to nape; cutout for the ear and exposed face on RIGHT. BACK: cover the ENTIRE original scalp with solid brown hair from crown to nape; only ears excluded.
Erase all eyes, eyebrows, noses, mouths, skin, ears, cheeks and face regions to FULL TRANSPARENCY. This is a modular hair-only overlay, NO head or facial features, NO skin. Very plain smooth hair-root silhouette with no strands, no hairstyle ornament, no texture. Dark outline only on outer contour and natural hairline. Preserve original cell anchors exactly, do not tightly recenter hair shapes. Transparent background, no text or grid.
